arguments.new_string:
The internal dictionary is available as ``api_call.memory``; its values are
    ``(result, timestamp)`` pairs. Raising ``api_call.skip(value)`` from the
    decorated function returns ``value`` without caching it (or returns ``None``
    if no value is supplied).

    Custom ``key_func`` could be used same way as in :func:`@memoize<memoize>`::
